title: This GTA 6 Street Race Can Vanish Forever 🏁 #Shorts
description:
GTA 6 has a missable street race. Yago's street races unlock in Chapter 3 after Dre'Quan's mission Dealer's Choice: the first race is in Salton, Vice City, you can rent one of three cars for $600-$900, and first place pays $3,000. Later, Race Against Yago shows up with an hourglass icon: if the timer runs out, the mission disappears. It pays up to $3,800.

Source: GTABase mission guides (Join a Street Race / Race Against Yago).
Images: official Rockstar Games footage (An Extended Look, official screenshot).
